terms.gloss: clasp hands, join right hand to right hand
evidence: Verg. A. 1.408: cūr dextrae jungere dextram nōn datur (Lewis & Short s.v. jungō)
Traupman 107: shake hands, dextrae jungere dextram

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. actions: shake hands. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 107.
Lewis & Short: jungo
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
